prompt:

Asset type: one transparent 2-column by 2-row facade-detail sprite atlas for a playable anime town, four separate architectural details with generous transparent space between them, no ground shadows.
Image 1 is the art style reference (existing painted town). Image 2 is an existing shuttered window reference for matching warm stone, teal wood, flower colors and scale, but simplify its photographic tiny texture into soft readable painted shapes.

TOP RIGHT: straight-on symmetrical gently arched small window, limestone arched lintel, green-teal painted wooden frame, four blue glass panes, short ivy on only one side, NO shutters, no planter.
BOTTOM LEFT: straight-on upright full-height teal painted wooden front door, cream limestone arched surround, small upper glass fanlight, brass handle on its right, two wooden inset panels, shallow stone sill.
BOTTOM RIGHT: straight-on upright full-height warm honey-brown timber shop door, rectangular cream stone lintel and side jambs, four small blue glass upper panes, wood panels below, brass handle on right, shallow stone sill.
Style: richly charming hand-painted gouache anime fantasy background art, broad tasteful color planes with controlled small brush marks, warm ivory, slate blue, sage teal, honey oak and soft pink flowers. NO perspective, no isometric angle, no leaning. Transparent around each complete frame, no walls, no floor, no furniture, no people, no words, no watermark. Keep every complete object inside its own quarter with empty transparent gutters; top windows slightly squarer than tall doors below.
